earnings.title: Newmont Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results with Record Third Quarter Adjusted Net Income; Positioned to Achieve Full-Year Guidance; Provides Update on Red Chris Block Cave Project
highlights: Reported Net Income of $2.5 billion, Adjusted Net Income (ANI) 3 of $2.3 billion or $2.20 per diluted share, and Adjusted EBITDA 3 of $4.0 billion
DENVER, October 22, 2026 – Newmont Corporation (NYSE: NEM, ASX: NEM, PNGX: NEM) (Newmont or the Company) today announced third quarter 2026 results and declared a dividend of $0.26 1 per share.
Generated $2.8 billion of cash from operating activities, net of working capital impacts of $565 million; reported third quarter Free Cash Flow 3 of $1.9 billion

Delivered $1.9 billion of shareholder returns through share repurchases and dividend payments since the last earnings call 4 ; declared a dividend of $0.26 per share of common stock for the third quarter of 2026
Through the date of filing, Newmont has repurchased $1.6 billion of common stock since the last earnings call 4 ; $2.8 billion remains under the current authorized program of $6.0 billion

quotes.text: Newmont remains on track to achieve our full-year 2026 production guidance and improved full-year cost outlook, supported by disciplined operational execution in the third quarter, demonstrating the strength and resilience of our world-class portfolio.
quotes.by: Natascha Viljoen, Newmont's President and Chief Executive Officer

outlook: On track to meet Newmont's full-year 2026 production guidance 2 of 5.3 million attributable gold ounces; produced 1.3 million attributable gold ounces, as well as 11 million ounces of silver and 23 thousand tonnes of copper, primarily from Newmont's managed operations

Gold by-product Costs Applicable to Sales (CAS) was $832 per ounce and All-In Sustaining Costs (AISC) was $1,454 per ounce 3 ; improved full-year cost guidance to $925 and $1,520 per ounce, respectively

Newmont expects to spend $1.95 billion in 2026 in sustaining capital through targeted investments in critical infrastructure, including tailings solutions, as detailed in the '2026 Guidance Expectations' section below.
As of the end of the third quarter, Newmont has invested $1.33 billion of sustaining capital in 2026, with full-year 2026 guidance remaining unchanged.
